note: Two real caves you can walk into: Mossback Cave west of Mosslight and Echo Hollow to the east, each marked on the world map, the atlas, and the minimap with its own cave-mouth icon. Walk up to the mouth and tap Enter cave to explore winding natural caverns built from the Kenney cave pieces — stone floors, rock walls, gates, and stairs — with the same monsters, loot, vaults, shops, and traps as a dungeon delve, but every floor is a rough cavern instead of built rooms. Mossback Cave moved a short way from its old spot because the old ground turned out to be a lake with nowhere dry to stand. Dungeons, towns, and your saves work exactly as before.
